title: Exploratory Testing
noSessionsHint: Write a charter and let the AI hunt for trouble in a real browser, listing suspicions as reviewable defect candidates.
pageHint: The AI explores a real browser against your charter, captures evidence for anything suspicious, and confirmed defects can be promoted to draft cases in one click.
charterPlaceholder: e.g. Explore the user management page's add/edit/delete flows and report any abnormal behaviour or missing validation.
charterHint: 10–4000 characters. State the goal and scope — the AI treats this as its boundary.
startUrlPlaceholder: Leave blank to start from the version environment's default entry
sessionNamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the first 80 characters of the charter
matrixPersonasHint: Pick 1 for a single session; pick several to explore the same charter in parallel (a persona matrix). Up to 6.
matrixLabelPlaceholder: Leave blank to name by persona count
multiViewHint: Multiple exploration personas independently reported the same defect (near-duplicate matching) — more credible.
allowFaultInjectionHint: Denied by default. Only with this enabled may the AI inject offline / slow-network / CPU-throttle to test error handling. A charter asking for it is not authorisation.
allowDestructiveHint: Denied by default. Only with this enabled may the AI click irreversible entries such as delete, pay or send. A charter asking to check them is not authorisation.
budgetTurnsHint: One turn = one page operation plus observation. Default 24, range 4–60.
rerunCreated: New session started with the same charter
noFindingsHint: Whatever the AI suspects will be listed here when the exploration ends.
codeScopeHintUrls: Hint entry points (heuristic, may be inaccurate — verify on actual pages)
promoteHint: Steps come from the platform-recorded action trail: steps that map mechanically carry DSL out of the box; the rest stay as natural language (compile with AI on the case detail page).
groupPlaceholder: Choose the group for the case
noGroups: This project has no groups yet
cancelConfirm: Cancelling stops this exploration as soon as possible; findings already collected are kept.
deleteConfirm: Deleting the session also deletes its defect candidates and evidence screenshots. This cannot be undone.
